name: kubernetes
description: Kubernetes: pods, resources and Helm via your kubeconfig (containers/kubernetes-mcp-server)

secrets.description: Optional: TOML config, e.g. with read_only = true

notes: Uses your kubeconfig and can change or delete resources. For read-only, create a TOML file with `read_only = true` and set K8S_MCP_CONFIG to its path.
